reason: The level/growth question and the fleet-mix question are estimated and governed separately, so neither is used to patch the other.
VFM202405 is a purpose-built fleet-transition projection and remains the production composition source under exact Base/Fast/Slow shares.
A published official vintage is an externally governed long-run view; using its SHAPE as a structural source is a transparent assumption.
Three named, published composition scenarios, selectable and auditable, rather than a fitted latent share.
Four dial parameters (speed, ceiling, midpoint, derived steepness) that a reviewer can read, change and re-fit. Verified from workbook cells.
Classes sum to the pool and PED VKT equals VKTpc x population, so the construction cannot quietly create or destroy kilometres.
Lambda was an allocation weight splitting one migration total between two streams. It was never estimated as behaviour and never weighted Current against MoT.

MBU26 proportions describe a universe containing BEV and PHEV kilometres; they were applied to a universe built from two conventional-only streams, so the optimiser had to manufacture EV km out of them.
The migration total was subtracted from the econometric levels themselves, changing what the models estimated.
Choosing a construction because its level lands near a published forecast is calibration to the answer, not a method.
Dividing a growing conventional forecast by a conventional share tending to zero produced the ~185,800 million km FY2050 pathology.
